title: Classic Car Tour of Hollywood
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Step back in time and discover Los Angeles from the comfort of a beautifully restored 1967 classic car—an experience that goes far beyond a typical sightseeing tour. Instead of riding in a crowded bus, you'll enjoy a private, personalized journey through some of LA's most iconic destinations in a timeless vintage vehicle that captures the glamour of Hollywood's golden era.
